mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, signaled by a positive YoY change in real GDP, indicates a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative > 40% of the time when GDPC1 YoY growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, indicated by a 1% MoM decline in INDPRO, signals a supply shock that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive > 60% of the time following a 1% MoM drop in INDPRO.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate, signaled by a 0.3pp increase in UNRATE over 3 months, indicates a weakening labor market that will negatively impact consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive > 40% of the time when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of falling housing starts and rising consumer sentiment indicates a shift from residential investment to consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are negative > 40% of the time when HOUST is falling and RSAFS is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A flattening yield curve, signaled by a narrowing spread between 10-year and 2-year Treasury yields, indicates a tightening of financial conditions that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive > 40% of the time when the yield curve is flattening.

mechanism_narrative: An accelerating pace of job growth, signaled by a 1% MoM increase in PAYEMS, indicates a strengthening labor market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are negative > 40% of the time following a 1% MoM increase in PAYEMS.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising consumer prices and falling real wages indicates a squeeze on household purchasing power that will negatively impact consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive > 40% of the time when CPIAUCSL is rising and AHE is falling.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in input costs, signaled by a 2% MoM rise in the PPI, indicates a supply shock that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive > 60% of the time following a 2% MoM rise in PPIACO.
